title: 汇丰Joey Chu：韩元为何下半年逆袭？资金流向是关键
speaker: Joey Chu

segments.en: Joining us now from Singapore is Joey Chu, head of Asia FX Research at HSBC. Joey, I'm wondering when you woke up this morning and saw this AI textile offer, what went through your mind in terms of what this means for FX markets now?
segments.zh: 汇丰亚洲外汇研究主管Joey Chu从新加坡加入我们。Joey，我想知道今早看到AI纺织报价时，你对当前外汇市场意味着什么有何想法？

segments.en: Well, yeah, when I saw the textile offer, first of all, I was very worried about Taiwan dollar.
segments.zh: 嗯，看到纺织报价时，我首先非常担心台币。

segments.en: More so than I am worried about Korean one.
I mean, I think it's been quite clear that Korean one has been trading on its own dynamics.
segments.zh: 我认为很明显韩元一直按自身动态交易。

segments.en: That is a little bit different from what's going on with the equity market, what's going on, even equity outflows from Korea itself.
segments.zh: 这与市场情况略有不同，甚至与韩国自身权益资产流出也不同。

segments.en: So I think it's because we are going into dividend season for some of the largest electronic makers in November and December, right?
segments.zh: 我认为这是因为11月和12月一些大型电子制造商进入分红季，对吧？

segments.en: So therefore, there could be some of this FX conversion or expectations of that that is still helping the Korean one more so than the Taiwan dollar.
segments.zh: 因此，可能存在一些外汇兑换或预期，这仍比台币更有利于韩元。

segments.en: Okay, well, talk to us a little bit more about the one.

Discuss perhaps if you could a little bit more detail on those dynamics and whether it can continue, because I simply look at the rankings. It's by far head and shoulders whether that spot total return.
segments.zh: 或许可以详细讨论这些动态以及能否持续，因为我只看排名，其现货总回报遥遥领先。

segments.en: The one's been winning and winning big Joe, and does that continue?
segments.zh: 韩元一直在赢且赢面很大，Joey，这会持续吗？

segments.en: Yes, indeed, but it if you realize it is a second half of the year type of phenomenon, right?
segments.zh: 是的，确实如此，但如果你意识到这是下半年才会出现的现象，对吧？

segments.en: The first half of the year was incredibly a huge underperformer because of the equity outflows.
segments.zh: 上半年表现非常糟糕，因为权益资产外流。

segments.en: So first of all, I think that some of the positioning has been a bit clean up after second quarter.
segments.zh: 所以首先，我认为第二季度后一些仓位已经有所清理。

segments.en: We had 30 billion of equity outflows per month in May and June.
segments.zh: 5月和6月，我们每月有300亿的权益资产外流。

segments.en: Recently, the equity outflows have been slowed down to maybe about 15 billion.
segments.zh: 最近，权益资产外流已放缓至约150亿。

segments.en: Still very large, but not as large as before.
segments.zh: 仍然很大，但不像之前那么大了。

segments.en: In the meanwhile, the current account surplus for Korea has gone from 25 billion to 50 billion.
segments.zh: 与此同时，韩国的经常账户盈余从250亿增加到500亿。

segments.en: So I think at this juncture, even if we were to get back to that kind of 30 billion outflows, they still look smaller than the current account surplus.
segments.zh: 所以我认为在这个节点，即使我们回到那种300亿的外流，它们看起来仍然小于经常账户盈余。

segments.en: So I think that is the key difference.
segments.zh: 所以我认为这是关键区别。
